Heus!

To get attention.

Other words

  • Heus tū! — hey, you!

    also used · classical · Plaut.; Ter.; Cic.; Traupman 213

  • Eho tū! — look here, you! (in a vehement question or a scolding)

    also used · classical · Plaut. Merc. 1.2.77; Ter. And. 5.4.5 (Lewis & Short s.v. eho); Traupman 341

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

Examples

  • Pater, «Heus, dā mihi manum!» identidem clāmitāns

    Dad, calling out again and again, “Hey, give me your hand!”Libellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam

  • «Heus tū!» inquit pater, custōdem agēns. «Quis es?»

    “Hey, you!” said Dad, playing the guard. “Who are you?”Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

  • sed heus tū! quid agis? ecquid fit?

    But hey, you! How are you? Anything happening?Cic. Fam. 7.11.2

  • Heus tū, tibi ego dīcō!

    Hey you, I’m talking to you!Traupman 328

See also oh no!.
